prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background for Mgo, a web anime visual novel; new exterior scene, not a UI mockup.
Input image 1: existing restaurant counter background, STYLE AND ARCHITECTURAL CONTINUITY REFERENCE ONLY. Generate the EXTERIOR of this restaurant.
Primary request: a welcoming McDonald's storefront seen straight-on from the pavement at a customer's eye level, golden afternoon sunlight. NO PEOPLE, no characters.
Scene: burgundy-red fascia with a single golden arches sign centered directly above the glass double entrance doors, warm cream and light oak architectural details, windows on both sides showing the softly lit oak-and-cream restaurant interior, quiet leafy city street. Glass doors have clear vertical frames and modest brass handles. Natural dappled tree shadows and a few restrained potted plants near the far edges.
Style: match the reference's sophisticated hand-painted slice-of-life anime background, crisp detailed architecture, warm luminous soft shading, restrained cream, burgundy, golden yellow and small pale sky blue accents.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape, symmetric central entrance, camera faces the door without perspective skew. Essential golden arches sign and BOTH entrance doors must fit together in the central 24 percent of the canvas width, for a very narrow portrait center-crop on phones. Include the complete sign above the door and the doorstep below, with vertical breathing room. Keep the center doorway unobstructed. The lower part is clean pavement for a separately rendered start button. Storefront spans the image and fills the height; no distant building view.
Constraints: one coherent storefront scene, no extra signs, no readable words or lettering, no slogans, no UI, no overlay logo card, no watermark, no pedestrians, no cars in front of the entrance, no character. The physical golden arches on the storefront are allowed and required. Do not reproduce the interior counter viewpoint.
